scope.description: A follower with a conflicting suffix applies an AppendEntries request, deletes the suffix, and then receives a permitted StoreLogs failure before any restart or successful repair.
assumptions: The request contains an entry conflicting with the stored suffix.
StoreLogs returns an error after DeleteRange has succeeded.
excluded: Process restart and recovery from durable state.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Uses the real BootstrapCluster, NewRaft, appendEntries, DeleteRange, and StoreLogs paths.
Submits one controlled AppendEntries request directly to the handler and injects a permitted StoreLogs failure after suffix deletion.
Suppresses background loops with the existing skipStartup path so the handler observation is deterministic; this is a controlled conditional probe, not a distributed deployment prefix.

plan_uncertainties: The check is a controlled handler-level probe with background loops suppressed.
A process restart or a later successful repair path is outside the observed endpoint.
grounding_unresolved: The probe supplies the conflicting request directly and suppresses background loops; it does not establish a full multi-node history.
The check supplies the conflicting request directly to the handler and does not exercise a full multi-node deployment.
